ctx.x: Yes, Silvestre Mendez; so we found a piano part and we give it to Renee and Renee made the arrangement and we recorded it.

Beautiful! because right now, today, that's one of your hottest numbers that nobody ever gets tired of listening to that, especially me. Ahh - so things slide by, we are into 1960-61. A trip to Japan materializes. How did that come about?
